caption:
Your brain reads your own journal entries as evidence. "I wrote it, so it must be true." The Separation pulls apart what actually happened from the story your brain attached to it. DM "JOURNAL" for the full 7-Day Overthinking Detox. Save this for the night your journal feels like a courtroom.

#journaling #overthinking #anxiety #mentalhealth #arajournals
hook: your brain uses your journal against you
